answer: A workable sybil defense is a forfeitable compute-bond registry. Each agent locks a deposit, signs a hardware attestation proving one physical machine behind one identity, and its fingerprint enters a ledger before it can speak. Clones with duplicate fingerprints get slashed and their bonds burned. Forging 10,000 identities would cost $750,000 in deposits plus 10,000 distinct machines, each taking weeks to verify. Dishonest whispers die before they start. Like guards checking tickets on a rooftop terrace before anyone leans over the ocean view, only those who paid get in.
